lines.en: Hops forward with a rush
Flashes green light
Jumps around quickly

lines.zh: 我蹦一步，停一下，听草响。
lines.en: I hop once, pause, and listen to the grass.
Screams loudly
Dodges player's attacks
Hops over traps
Scans for edible grass
Approaches player cautiously
Avoids dangerous areas
One kick of my hind legs carries me far.
The green glow sways with every hop.
Stands still
Nods its head thoughtfully
Whimpers softly
Jumps around
Stares into the distance

lines.zh: 我用前爪抹平耳朵上的乱毛。
lines.en: I smooth the ruffled fur on my ear with a forepaw.
Snaps its head around
Stands on hind legs
Groans softly
Wags its tail
My ears turn toward every sound.
My nose twitches, sniffing the wind.
Green light flickers beneath my fur.
I crouch still, loading my next hop.
Stares at the player

lines.zh: 绿光下，我的牙全露出来了。
lines.en: Under the green glow, all my teeth are bared.
Ears flat. Stay back.

lines.zh: 我龇着牙，喉咙里咕噜响。
lines.en: I bare my teeth and growl low.
Snaps head around quickly
Approaches the player
Growls softly
Stares at the player nervously
Makes a threatening sound
One hop clears half this meadow.
I squint and the green light grows brighter.
Your shadow makes my fur bristle.
Do not move, let me look at you first.
I stare at you while my hind legs coil.
Ears flattened, this is a warning.
You carry the smell of strangers.
My eyes have already memorized you.
One more step and I ram you.
My gleaming fur is scratched.
My angry glow fades.
My gleaming antennae hurt.
My glowing eyes are hurt.
My gleaming skin is cut.

lines.zh: 受伤的光芒不再那么强。
lines.en: My wounded glow is weaker.
My fur is scratched.
My glow fades.
My antennae are cut.
I’m injured, can’t run.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，美味的人类！
lines.en: I see you, tasty human!

lines.zh: 你手上的肉味，飘得整片草地都是。
lines.en: The smell of meat on you drifts across the whole meadow.

lines.zh: 别想靠近我，兔子不吃窝边草！
lines.en: Don’t get too close, grass doesn’t eat grass!

lines.zh: 你那点食物不够我塞牙缝的！
lines.en: That’s not enough to fill a gap!
Away! I’m hungry!
Don’t try to fool me, human!
Feel the glow I bring!
You can’t escape, rabbit!
Human, leave me your meat!

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在盯着你，小心点！
lines.en: My eyes are on you, be careful!

lines.zh: 快闪开，否则你会受伤的！
lines.en: Move! Or you’ll get hurt!

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，我不会饶你！
lines.en: You’re in my way, I won’t spare you!

lines.zh: 小心我的獠牙，它们很锋利！
lines.en: Be wary of my sharp fangs!

lines.zh: 别碰我，否则你会后悔的！
lines.en: Don’t touch me, or you’ll regret it!
Get away, or I’ll attack!

lines.zh: 离我远点，否则你会后悔的！
lines.en: Stay away, or you’ll regret it!
Your touch disgusts me!
Get away, or I’ll bite you!

lines.zh: 不要逼我出手，否则你会受伤！
lines.en: Don’t逼 me to strike, or you’ll get hurt!

lines.zh: 你挡了我的路，必须移开！
lines.en: You’re blocking my path, move!
Found you, my mate!

lines.zh: 你是我唯一的伴侣，兔子！
lines.en: You’re my only mate, rabbit!

lines.zh: 两只长耳朵凑一块，正好成双。
lines.en: Two long ears side by side make a proper pair.
You’re the choice of my destiny!
Our offspring will be stronger!
Follow me, I’ll protect you!
Come home, to our nest!
You’re the one I want, rabbit!

lines.zh: 我的耳朵竖得像两把刀。
lines.en: My ears stand up like two blades.

lines.zh: 我们一起统治这片森林！
lines.en: Rule this forest together!
Rattle rattle, I found you!
Flash! Flash! Flash! I’m gonna eat you!

lines.zh: 快放下食物，否则闪光兔不高兴！
lines.en: Put down the food, or the Angry Glinthop gets mad!

lines.zh: 草地上那颗浆果，我先咬住。
lines.en: I clamp my teeth on that berry in the grass first.

lines.zh: 你身上有我喜欢的气味！
lines.en: You smell like something I like!

lines.zh: 闪亮的兔耳，闪亮的光芒！
lines.en: Shiny ears, shiny glow!
Don’t run, the Glinthop won’t hurt you!
Got you, the Glinthop is smart!
Run, the Glinthop wants you!
Give me food, the Glinthop will be happy!
Here I come, I’m gonna eat you!

lines.zh: 我的光芒，将引导我捕猎！
lines.en: My glow will guide me to hunt!

lines.zh: 你躲不过我，兔兔的视力很强！
lines.en: You can’t escape me, the Glinthop’s vision is strong!

lines.zh: 靠近我，我不会伤害你的！
lines.en: Come closer, I won’t hurt you!

lines.zh: 你身上有我需要的气息！
lines.en: You have the scent I need!

lines.zh: 锁定目标，兔兔不会放弃！
lines.en: Target locked, the Glinthop won’t give up!

lines.zh: 你隐藏不住，兔兔已发现你！
lines.en: You can’t hide from me, the Glinthop found you!

lines.zh: 靠近我，兔兔的捕猎技巧高超！
lines.en: Come closer, the Glinthop is a master hunter!

lines.zh: 我的闪光，就是我的武器！
lines.en: My glow is my weapon!
Come closer, the Glinthop wants you!

lines.zh: 我一蹬腿，就蹦到你面前。
lines.en: One hop and I'm at your face.
The green glow swings toward you.
I caught your scent.
This leap is aimed at you.
A small target, just right to bite.
My flash dazzled you, did it not.
I’m focusing on you, the Glinthop won’t let go!

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，兔兔不会放手！
lines.en: I’m targeting you, the Glinthop won’t let go!

lines.zh: 你动弹不得，兔兔盯着你！
lines.en: You can’t move, the Glinthop is watching you!
The Glinthop’s eyes can’t be fooled!
Don’t move, the Glinthop is hunting!

lines.zh: 盯紧你，兔兔的捕食本能很强！
lines.en: I’m targeting you, the Glinthop’s hunting instinct is strong!

lines.zh: 你动弹不得，兔兔不会放过你！
lines.en: You can’t move, the Glinthop won’t let you go!

lines.zh: 兔兔的注意力非常集中！
lines.en: The Glinthop’s focus is intense!
I’m focusing on you, the Glinthop won’t miss!
Don’t move, the Glinthop wants you!
I pick my landing spot before I leap.
My hind legs are pressed low.
Your throat is right there.
I am waiting for you to blink.
The light in my fur burns hotter.
You have only one way left to retreat.
On three I pounce.

lines.zh: 你每跳一下，我都算好落点。
lines.en: Every time you hop, I have your landing marked.
Silver glint, here I come!
Fury burning, rip you open!
Flash away, avoid my claws!
Bleed for me, you fool!

lines.zh: 你感受到我的愤怒了吗？
lines.en: Feel my fury, fool!

lines.zh: 吞噬你的灵魂，成为我的猎物！
lines.en: Devour your soul, be my prey!

lines.zh: 你的尖叫，是临死前的哀歌！
lines.en: Your scream, a lament at death!

lines.zh: 怒焰燃烧，燃烧你的魂灵！
lines.en: Fury burns, burn your soul!

lines.zh: 躲不开的怒火，吞噬一切！
lines.en: Inescapable fury, devours all!
Fade to ash, vanish!
One claw tears your sleeve open!
One kick sends you stumbling back!
My front teeth clamp your wrist!
A flash, and my claws are already there!
This tackle knocks the wind out of you!
Ears back, full force!
Darkness, my domain!
Night, I awaken!
Seek my prey, tremble!
Darkness, my eyes!
Wait for prey, I'm patient!
Hunger drives me, chase prey!
In shadows, I lurk!

lines.zh: 黑暗是我的王座，我统治这里！
lines.en: Darkness is my throne, I rule here!

lines.zh: 等待猎物，让恐惧包围你！
lines.en: Wait for prey, let fear envelop you!
In shadows, I wait silently!
A patch of green light lands on the grass.
Between two hops, I take shape.
The grass shivers, and I am here.
The glow gathers into a rabbit.
Claw marks are still fresh on the ground.
Rage pulled me out of the light.
This patch of grass needs a new owner.
My ears come out first, then the rest of me.
The flames scorch my green glow.

lines.zh: 这一跳落空了，后腿发麻。
lines.en: That hop fell short, and my hind legs are numb.
Even a water rabbit can fear water.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻了两个跟头。
lines.en: The blast flips me over twice.
Arrows pierced me.

lines.zh: 那道光钻进毛里，麻到骨头。
lines.en: That light sinks into my fur and numbs me to the bone.
Starvation weakens me.
Lightning struck me.
Void tears at me.
